description: Projects by Anuv Gupta, engineer and artist.

projects.name: SkyTube – Watch YouTube In Skyrim
projects.description: Video player mod for Skyrim. Watch YouTube, streams, or videos while you play. Auto-pauses during dialogue. Picture-in-picture with resize, drag, fade. Resumes last video when you load in. SKSE plugin, no ESP, nothing in saves.

screenshots.alt: A YouTube video playing in a picture-in-picture window over a Skyrim sunset

projects.name: Project Portfolio
projects.description: This site: a Windows XP-style desktop built with Astro, with draggable windows, a Start menu and a live, procedurally drawn wallpaper.

projects.name: Murk3D
projects.description: A dreamy high fantasy open-world RPG built with Three.js. Roam a lush vale of rolling hills and forests under dazzling sunsets and vibrant mornings. Not for the faint hearted... unless you like cozy villages, legendary swords and magical artifacts, big bouncy mushrooms, and vast, ethereal landscapes.

screenshots.alt: Murk's title screen over a moonlit village path: "A tale of the Vale"

projects.name: Self-Hosted Voice Assistant
projects.description:
A voice assistant on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a four-mic array:

* Custom Claude harness for replies and tool calling to smart home (Home Assistant) and media server (Jellyfin/Radarr).
* Fine-tuned Laya decision model to smart wake without wake word. Self-hosted alongside Whisper on an old GPU for privacy and speed.
* Deepgram speech-to-text, Piper text-to-speech. Pipecat for Silero, Smart Turn, and the pipeline.

Just ask!

screenshots.alt: The voice assistant's screen moving between resting, listening, speaking and smart wake states

projects.name: notes-sync – Search Notes with AI
projects.description: Access your iCloud notes via AI search tools like vector search and/or Claude. Keeps a folder of Markdown files in sync with Apple Notes every 15 seconds, so Obsidian, grep or Basic Memory's semantic search can read your notes. Plain Python, run as a macOS launchd agent.

projects.name: PiWii – Ask Your Wii For Games
projects.description:
Install games onto your Wii over WiFi. Access a massive game library directly on the Wii, no discs.

* Raspberry Pi 4B powers and passes through a 1 TB drive over USB to a Wii modded with Homebrew and USBLoaderGX.
* Self-hosted website takes requests and game files, then converts & uploads games to the Pi's NFS over LAN.

projects.name: turnstile-solver
projects.description:
A fork of a Cloudflare Turnstile solver for scraping stricter websites:

* Original solves challenge on a fake local page & returns the token.
* Strict sites only unlock their content when the token is *both* solved and redeemed on their own page.
* This fork solves on the real page with a hardened browser fingerprint, lets the page unlock itself, and returns the content behind the challenge rather than a token.

projects.name: git-autosync
projects.description: Auto-commits, syncs, and pushes any git repo on a schedule, each repo with its own scheduler and lock. Works on macOS (launchd), Linux (cron or systemd) and Windows. Great for AI-managed markdown knowledge bases.

projects.name: Projector Screen Controller
projects.description: An ESPHome controller for a motorized projector screen. A Home Assistant automation lowers it whenever the NVIDIA Shield is on or the projector's smart plug shows it drawing power, and raises it once both are off.

screenshots.alt: The controller board: an ESP32 on perfboard with a transistor, resistors and a screw terminal for the screen's wires
The controller in its black case, mounted on the end of the projector screen housing

projects.name: Presence-Based LED Light Strips
projects.description: Hallway LED strips that follow you as you walk: LD2450 mmWave radar sensors publish targets over MQTT, a fusion service tracks each person along the hallway, and WLED strips light up where they are. Ambient light controls and occupancy show up in Home Assistant.

projects.name: Sound Design AI – Talk to Your Synthesizer
projects.description:
Added a voice chat agent to the open-source Vital wavetable synth.

* Describe what you want instead of hunting through menus for knobs.
* Shape sounds hands-free, while you play keys.
* Iterate through synth patches faster.

Never touch your synth again.

screenshots.alt: Typing a request into the chat panel in Vital; the agent turns on oscillator 2, sets it to a square wave, and keys are played

projects.name: CityScape
projects.description: A procedurally generated 3D city in a single HTML file with Three.js: skyscrapers clustered into downtowns, buildings of varied footprints and heights with shader-drawn lit windows, sliders to reshape the skyline, and touch controls tuned for iPad Safari.

projects.name: Sketchy – Image Gen Sketchpad
projects.description: A website for generating images with Stable Diffusion: a ComfyUI worker on RunPod's serverless GPUs, AWS infrastructure in CDK, and a simple web frontend.

projects.name: b.js – Build Automation Script
projects.description: A tiny Node CLI that runs named build targets from a project's b.json, like a lightweight Make. Used across my web and infrastructure repos.

projects.name: Edge AI – Computer Vision Competition
projects.description: Compressed MobileNet into a 30 KB network that predicts in about 1 ms with over 70% accuracy on CIFAR-10. Won 1st in the speed competition for UT's EE379K Edge AI course.

projects.name: Rubbr.io
projects.description: A multiplayer .io-style car arena with socket.io and HTML5 canvas: crash cars, collect cash and race to the top of the leaderboard.

screenshots.alt: rubbr gameplay: a car among cash pickups

projects.name: block.js – Simple UI Prototyping
projects.description: A lightweight JavaScript library for building web UIs from modular, event-driven templates. Never touch HTML again.
